notes.title: Movie and Achievements fixed
notes.notes:
Please swap to beta branch to receive the fixes, we're still doing testing but we feel this version is stable for people to opt in to playing to get best user experience.

Go to Steam library, right click the game in your library, select properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811466/25b89b2f7fbc1c7d3ad986574593d4e06b4e5dce.jpg[/img]

Go to BETAS tab and click the drop down menu to opt in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811466/334b2892df9d522b7abace85549e7850575899ac.jpg[/img]

If you do not see the option to download the beta please try restarting your Steam client.
